title: Hell's Angels chief zapped at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: has another story of a Hell's Angels chief or whatever, you know, getting zapped and then a catatonic steak just just, you know, paralyzed there.

plain: A leader of the Hell's Angels biker gang is said to have been "zapped" by something at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, and left paralyzed and catatonic on the spot. Michels mentions it only in passing, as one more story he credits to a man named Brandon Fugal, and gives no date and no other details. If true, it would mean whatever happens on the ranch can physically disable people.
